summary: 8 of 8 applicable boxes (.110 .123 .124 .133 .143 .171 .184 .240) were proven in the SAME live baseq3 FFA game on the dev host's quake3-server :27961 (q3tourney2), at the same time. I checked this myself, not from the round agent's report: rcon status mapped every Fleet<octet> name to its own IP, with no CNCT. All 8 sent sustained packets (505-1486 in 12 s). All 8 frames show live 3D at the box's fullscreen target. .124 and .171 each show the other's name tag in the world. A fresh F5 on each box (foreground ioquake3 checked first) produced a new 'say: FleetNNN' line on the server at 15:47:18 for all 8. .186 and .243 are NA: .186 has no 3D driver on 32-bit Win7, and .243 is gated with an operator override. lanparty.py kill closed ioquake3 gracefully on all 8 at 15:48 (WM_CLOSE, no force). PROCLIST then showed no game process and no crash reporter. Every desktop is back at its persisted mode, and the server roster is back to its 3 bots.
issues: lanparty.py kill does not accept '--game' (argparse exit 2, 'unrecognized arguments: --game'). The working form is 'lanparty.py kill Quake3Arena --out ...'. The orchestrator's prompt template uses '--game': fix the template or the tool. Warning: a bare 'lanparty.py kill' with no game closes EVERY party game on the default box list.

.171 (cosmetic): its 3D view is inset inside a dark border (cg_viewsize below 100). This probably comes from the stray box-local q3config.cfg in the install tree, which the recipe review found on .124 .133 .143 .171 and which GAMESYNC never deletes. In my 15:46 frame the status bar and score box DO draw, which corrects the round agent's 'no status bar' note.

.124 is the slowest client: 42 fps in its frame and 505 pkts/12 s against ~1486 on the fast boxes. It is still sustained and in game. It runs entirely on our own stack (MesaFX ICD + h5 Glide + vcr-kmd on the V5 6000). It was closed with WM_CLOSE and needed no relaunch.

quake3-server: according to the round agent, with only bots connected it froze at intermission (q3dm17, 'Exit: Timelimit hit.' from 14:20:29 until the round) and needed one human UIKEY RETURN to change map. It now holds only its 3 bots on q3tourney2, so a later round may again find it at intermission and need one RETURN on a box whose foreground is ioquake3.

Not a round leftover: .124's foreground after the close is its pre-existing agent watchdog console 'cmd.exe - C:\RETRO_AGENT\agentwd.cmd'. retro_chat consoles are open on .133 .143 .240 as usual. There are no crash dialogs or wrong desktop modes: live == persisted on all 8.

Evidence from this final pass is under rounds/final/ (check report Quake3Arena.json, frames Quake3Arena_<octet>.jpg, grid_final.jpg, rcon status, server journal, F5 proof, kill log, post-close PROCLIST/WINLIST/DISPLAYCFG, GAMERES modes, post-close desktop frames grid_postkill.jpg). The round agent's evidence in rounds/ was left untouched.
